source: Alpaca IEX bars; $20 positions, 2 slots, after spread, slippage and fees (daily cent rounding)

rows.label: H1 momentum, held to the close
H3 = H1 with a passive limit entry
H2 gap stocks in play, breakout

note: gap stocks in play moved the most (+2.1% at best on average) but kept only +0.09% per trade before costs, and a $20 round trip in them costs about 0.28% (wider spreads plus fees rounded up to a cent each day). holding momentum signals to the close did not help (-0.02% before costs). a passive limit entry filled 74% of the time — mostly on trades that went on to lose (-0.19% when filled vs +0.12% when not).
trend: research only (the app never holds overnight): an SPY trend filter returned +33% vs +43% buy-and-hold, and its worst drop was 8% instead of 19%, but after testing five ideas it can't be told apart from luck (adjusted p=0.12). holding index ETFs overnight lost -0.08% per night after costs; its worst night was -5.4%.
conclusion: No phase 2 strategy passed: every one lost money after costs on the unseen holdout, or could not be told apart from luck.
